newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ROBSON STILL AWAITS NEWS OF EMERSON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROBSON STILL AWAITS NEWS OF EMERSON.

text.p: Middlesbrough manager Bryan Robson appeared ready to adopt a hardline approach towards missing Brazilian Emerson on Thursday if he did not meet a new deadline for returning to the club.
The manager of the English premier club arrived at the Riverside Stadium on Thursday morning and admitted he was still waiting to hear from Emerson.

Chairman Steve Gibson has threatened to impose a hefty fine on the four million pounds ($6.6 million) player and ask FIFA to impose a world-wide ban if Emerson continues to defy the club by refusing to return and honour his four-year contract.
Robson arrived at the club's ground and would only say: "I've heard nothing."
Club officials say they were expecting Emerson to return to Middlesbrough on Wednesday and report for training on Thursday.

The 24-year-old Brazilian returned home for what was believed to be a brief holiday but was then reported as saying he would not be coming back to Middlesbrough and wanted to negotiate his release from the club.
He said the reason for his unrest was the homesickness of girlfriend Andrea, but Barcelona's reported interest in the player could also be a factor.
Barcelona boss Bobby Robson reluctantly sold Emerson to Boro in the summer while he was in charge of Porto and is believed to be interested in recapturing him.
Bryan Robson has stressed that Emerson must honour his contract and said: "I have to speak to a few people about newspaper reports. I want to find out what is the truth and what is not.
"Emerson will not be leaving the club. In fact no-one is leaving unless I decide it is in our best interests. I have the full backing of the chairman over this."
